body.condition: The schedule satisfies \(D_a(Y)\le s\) for each \(a\in\{0,1\}\).

novel.justification: The condition is a transparent sensitivity restriction on latent potential outcomes, analogous to varying an unobserved-confounding radius. Smaller values are substantively plausible for pairs formed from near-duplicate baseline profiles, but pretreatment records cannot verify both-arm discordance; conclusions are therefore reported across analyst-selected values of \(s\).
